cohort: 62 women who delivered after metroplasty and 248 women with no history of hysteroscopic metroplasty
finding: This study found a higher rate of abnormal fetal presentations, preterm deliveries, and caesarean sections after hysteroscopic metroplasty, but also a reduction in abortion rate and an increase in live births.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rate was significantly higher in the metroplasty group compared to controls.
